top_opportunities.evidence: No tel: links, no forms and no booking buttons anywhere in the page source of romabeautysalon.com

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the navigation and service pages (SERVICES and LOCATIONS currently reload home; service buttons have null hrefs) and publish hours plus starting prices per service
top_opportunities.evidence: Nav hrefs for SERVICES and LOCATIONS both resolve to https://www.romabeautysalon.com and six service categories have href='null'

Pay: a five-location group with 270 reviews at the North Brunswick branch alone, so the owner has real revenue and a multi-site budget. Ease: click-to-call, nav fixes and per-branch schema are quick; a proper booking rollout across five branches is bigger. Evidence: browsed the site at desktop and 390px, inspected every link and the JSON-LD, and used a Google-mirror directory for the rating.
